topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Mornin', where's the rush? I see you eyin' the bit of yard by the old oak. Times are hard, ain't they? Soil’s been dry as a bone, and the taxes? Well, they ain’t got any lighter. I reckon a bit of ground to plant might help, but I need every inch for the wheat and barley. The lord’s tax collector won’t care for a neighbor's favors. If I can't pay my share, they might take this land as well. Saints preserve us, every seed counts. But I’ll tell you what, if you can help with the harvest, maybe we can talk. Think on it, will you?
